title: Claude Code Plugin Manifest
description: Schema for plugin.yaml files in optional_plugins/[category]/ directories. Declares skills, compatibility, and load policies.

plugin_id.description: Unique identifier for this plugin (e.g., 'youtube-core', 'geometry-rhino'). Must be lowercase alphanumeric and hyphenated.

category.description: Functional category. Determines directory placement and activation rules.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this plugin provides.

project_types.description: Which project types this plugin is relevant for. When a project has one of these types and auto_enable=true, this plugin loads automatically.

name.description: Skill name (must match directory in optional_plugins/[category]/[name]/).

version.description: Skill version (should match version in skill's SKILL.md metadata).

load_policy.description: When this skill loads: 'auto' = loaded with plugin, 'on-demand' = user must enable, 'disabled' = not available in this plugin version.

skills.description: Array of skills contained in this plugin. Can be empty in v1.0 for placeholder plugins (skills added during Phase 11.2).

max_os_version.description: Maximum AI OS version supported (null = no upper bound).

min_model_version.description: Minimum Claude model required (e.g., 'claude-sonnet-5'). If omitted, plugin is model-agnostic.

max_model_version.description: Maximum Claude model supported (null = no upper bound).

auto_enable.description: If true, this plugin is automatically enabled when a matching project_type is detected (and manifest.auto_include=true or manifest.plugins contains this plugin_id). If false, user must explicitly enable.

keywords.description: Tags for plugin discovery and categorization.

dependencies.description: Other plugins that must be loaded before this one (e.g., ['geometry-core']).

conflicts.description: Plugins that cannot be active simultaneously with this one.
